# Crown Race — Race for the Crown (crownrace.site)

An on-chain racing game for Binance Agent ID (.ai NFT) holders on BNB Chain (chainId 56).

## Status
PRE-LAUNCH. The game contract (CrownRaceGame) is not deployed yet. Do not attempt to enter or move yet; the contract address will be published here at launch.

## How it works
- Weekly heats: Monday 00:00 UTC to Monday 00:00 UTC. Track length: 100 steps.
- enterRookie(): free (0 value), 1 racer per wallet per heat, caller must hold a Binance Agent ID NFT (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). Starts at step 0.
- enterPro(): paid entry in the project token $CROWN (launching on four.meme), up to 3 racers per wallet per heat. Starts at step 5.
- move(racerId): free, once per UTC day per racer, advances 1-6 steps. The step draw is derived from on-chain block data and is verifiable after the fact (not VRF-grade).
- nitro(racerId, tier): optional paid boost in $CROWN: tier 0 = +2 steps, tier 1 = +7 steps, tier 2 = +20 steps.
- settleHeat(heatId): permissionless after the heat ends or once a racer finishes at step 100. The winner (first finisher, else farthest, ties by earliest reach) receives 50% of the heat pool automatically; 50% goes to the project.

## Token
$CROWN (BNB Chain, via four.meme) is the in-game currency for Pro entries and Nitro. It can be obtained only by buying it or by earning it from paid play (Pro entry cashback and heat-winner pools). No airdrop.
